taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: Web cache poisoning and deception — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map cache key, Vary behavior, cacheability, normalization, origin inputs and account partitioning at the actual cache. Distinguish poisoning from private-response reuse/deception.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an isolated cache namespace or replica and a unique fixture path. Prime with the single suspect unkeyed input, then request as a separate clean controlled client without that input. Observe the poisoned marker, cache source and expected lifetime; purge owned fixture entries afterward.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Reflection visible only to the priming request is not poisoning. A cache miss or correct Vary separation defeats that test. Shared private data and attacker-altered public content have different impacts.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Align response influence with cache keys or remove unsafe cacheability at the evidenced layer. Retest clean-client reuse, legitimate cache hits and private account separation where relevant.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
